Tier2 link conversion with accessible names disabled

```python title="Python"
from html_to_markdown import convert_with_accessible_names, ConversionOptions, InlineDataMedia, TierStrategy

def main() -> None:
    html = '<p>see <a href="https://example.com/x">GitHub<svg aria-label="(opens in new tab)"><use href="#ext"></use></svg></a> now</p>'
    use_accessible_names = False
    options = ConversionOptions(inline_data_media=InlineDataMedia("AltTextOnly"), tier_strategy=TierStrategy("tier2"))
    result = convert_with_accessible_names(html, use_accessible_names, options)
    print(result.content)

main()
```
